rules.text: A change to headings 7401 through 7403 from any other heading.

No change in tariff classification required for goods of heading 7404, provided that the waste and scrap are wholly obtained or produced entirely in Australia or the United States or the territory of Australia or of the United States as defined in this note.
A change to headings 7405 through 7407 from any other heading.
A change to heading 7408 from any other heading except from heading 7407.
A change to heading 7409 from any other heading.
A change to heading 7410 from any other heading, except from plate, sheet, or strip classified in heading 7409 of a thickness less than 5 mm.
A change to headings 7411 through 7418 from any other heading.
A change to heading 7419 from any other heading.

warning: Not updated for Pres.Proc. 8771, effective Feb. 3, 2012
